sections.title: Hair and more
sections.content: haj ("hair") is the missing piece from A1's appearance words — you already have szőke and barna for hair color, and here are two more: fekete ("black", already known) and vörös ("red, ginger").
X haja van ("has X hair") reuses the have-construction from A1 plus the 3rd-person possessive -a/-e from Unit 3 — haj becomes haja because it's HIS or HER hair being described.
